CHAPTER 7 · ITEM 09 / 10

Efficiency and welfare

Efficiency assumptions效率假設

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Distinguish efficiency from equality and identify circumstances, including market power and externalities, where the simple competitive-efficiency conclusion may not hold.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

效率最大化總剩餘，平等關心分配。市場效率結論依賴價格接受及無相關外部性等條件；壟斷力量或外部影響可破壞結論。

Efficiency maximizes total surplus; equality concerns distribution. The competitive-efficiency result assumes conditions such as price taking and no relevant external effects. Market power or externalities can break the result.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：A market may maximize buyer-plus-seller surplus yet impose pollution costs on residents. Social surplus must include these costs. 必須加入第三方成本。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Which issue can invalidate the simple competitive-efficiency conclusion? 何者可能推翻簡單效率結論？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
